outcome: diagnosis of squamous cell cancer of the vulva
prevention of vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia and vulvar cancer
cohort: Adult women (18 years and older) diagnosed with squamous cell cancer of the vulva are the target population for these guidelines.
finding: This guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for the clinical evaluation, diagnosis, and comprehensive management of squamous cell cancer of the vulva, utilizing surgical, radiation, and chemotherapy options, alongside sentinel lymph node assessment and HPV vaccination.
